group_context: Six standalone satirical Odyssey-inspired mythic and concept costume archetypes. No historical likeness, canonical deck mapping or inferred pair/trio relations.

figuren.name: Penelope Aufschub

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: PENELOPE, FEMALE-READ patience stretched to breaking. Broad compact pear ink blob, tiny ivory headcloth folded back above face, two small curled clay side locks, plain bronze pin, short faded red shoulder fold. Very unequal white eyes glare SIDEWAYS, one lowered lid and one high questioning brow, huge compressed crooked lower lip, one small upper tooth. Holds ONE tiny WOODEN WEAVING FRAME across lower belly: two chunky uprights and just a few visible cream horizontal threads, with ONE thick wooden SHUTTLE gripped beside it. A loose end of yarn comes off one corner, hinting at unweaving. Simple legible mechanism, no complex loom or text. Complete ink body visible.

figuren.name: Polyphem Einblick

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: POLYPHEMUS, MALE-READ hungry cyclops with wounded pride but NO bodily injury. Very wide low heavy bean blob, one enormously thick continuous CENTER WHITE EYE with red iris/black pupil, massive single arched brow lifted in bewilderment, no second eye. Two tiny blunt crown lobes, a single rough brown leather shoulder strap. Slanted half-open foolishly offended mouth with two huge unequal lower teeth, big heavy lip. Both hands hold ONE large rounded wedge of pale clay CHEESE with only three simple holes, protected against belly as his prized possession. No sheep, club, stake or extra creature.

source_motif.visual_anchor: one white-red-black eye and cheese; no injury

figuren.name: Odysseus Umweg

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: ODYSSEUS, MALE-READ calculating homecomer. Tall hooked teardrop blob with one long curled crown lobe, small cream pointed felt traveller cap tilted back, short navy-blue shoulder scrap, two short dark clay beard curls only along chin sides, mouth fully visible. Cool cunning near-smile with one lifted lip corner and one tiny offset tooth, white eyes glance sideways in different degrees of squint, brows thoughtfully uneven. Holds ONE short thick ancient WOODEN BOW vertically beside his own body, visible single bowstring attached to both tips, ONE plain leather tied travel pouch pressed against belly. Not aiming, no arrow flying or map scene.

figuren.name: Poseidon Gegenstrom

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: POSEIDON, MALE-READ sea authority in a terrible mood. Broad upright near-square ink splat with wave-like thick rounded lobes, two small sea-green clay beard curls at sides of mouth, small dull bronze crown with THREE low rounded points, short teal shoulder fold. Exhausted imperial irritation, one white eye stares down and one narrowed sideways, heavily unequal brows, enormous skewed open rectangular mouth with only three widely spaced irregular teeth, huge lower lip. Grips ONE SHORT thick bronze TRIDENT upright close beside body, exactly three broad rounded prongs completely within cell. No water, foam background, fish, waves outside body or ocean scene.

source_motif.visual_anchor: trident/crown as conventional iconography, not a literal scene

figuren.name: Kirke Nachwürze

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: CIRCE, FEMALE-READ enchantress quietly pleased with her hospitality. Tall soft wavy-edged pear blob, one simple violet headband, short dark clay curl, subtle lashes, very small muted purple shoulder fold. Serene dangerous amusement: half-lidded white eyes looking DOWN at own cup, one brow curved upward, almost CLOSED lopsided smile with two tiny unequal teeth. Holds ONE small bronze CUP whose handle is shaped like a chunky simple PIG SNOUT and rounded ears, and ONE short fat wooden WAND angled into cup. Pig shape is an inanimate handle design, NOT an extra pig character. No potion mist, floating symbols or witch hat. Face unobstructed.

source_motif.visual_anchor: pig-snout cup and stirring wand; no seventh pig actor

figuren.name: Aiolos’ Restdruck

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug:
AEOLUS'S BAG OF WINDS PERSONIFIED, MALE-READ absurd living ink windbag. Bulky top-heavy sack-like dark ink splat, upright/footless with rounded pooled lobes, NO separate humanoid wearing a bag. The body itself reads subtly as bulging tied bellows while staying purple-black plasticine ink, not brown cloth. One loose thick cream ROPE COLLAR gathered around upper body below face, two goo hands desperately hold its knot shut at belly. Panicked breath-holding, huge puffed cheeks, unequal wide WHITE/red/black eyes look DOWN, clenched small zigzag mouth with one tooth, inner brow corners high. ONE small opaque ivory clay curl of wind escapes under knot right beside hand, short compact sculpted curl entirely inside silhouette margin, no air clouds or flying symbols. No additional sack, hat, boat or character.

Composition: regular3x2 grid, six LARGE complete independent figures, similar substantial body height on both rows, distinct silhouettes even without props. Full silhouettes450-475px tall inside512px logical cells, generous clear outer margins/gutters especially at least24-32px between rows. All hats/weaving frame/bow/cheese/trident/cup/rope/curl/droplets inside own cell. No touching/overlap/props across seams, no cropped details or miniature bottom row. No gridlines, text, letters, watermark, scenery, floor, shadow disc, backdrop gradient, checkerboard or halo. Real alpha-zero transparent background and opaque character interiors, clean antialiased edges. Soft upper-left studio light on characters only.

source_motif.visual_anchor: sack-like ink creature holding rope knot, not a portrait of Aeolus
